channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Nunes Marques dá 24h para Meta detalhar atuação do 'Exército do Lula'; as últimas notícias antes do 2º turno
item.description: A new Datafolha poll released one hour before the second round shows a statistical tie between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), both with 50% of valid votes. The survey, conducted between October 20 and 22, interviewed 2,520 people and has a margin of error of plus or minus two points. In total votes, including whites, nulls, and undecideds, Flávio leads with 47%, followed by Lula with 46%.

item.title: Pesquisa segundo turno, Lula e Flávio: o que dizem os levantamentos para presidente
item.description: Recent polls for the 2026 Brazilian presidential runoff between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) indicate a tight race, with Bolsonaro generally ahead but within the margin of error. Leading institutes (PoderData/Aya, Quaest and Meio/Ideia) show minimal swings in the lead, underscoring the competitiveness of the election.

item.title: Manifesto: A 3 dias das urnas, Kassio dobra aposta na intervenção das redes
item.description: The TSE presidency authorized direct intervention in the official social media accounts of campaigns, allowing parties and candidates to manipulate content on digital platforms. The decision, made 72 hours before the elections, intensifies ideological control over political communication and increases the risk of structured disinformation.

item.title: 'Bolsonaro Talvane Albuquerque': por que Janones incentivou busca no Google
item.description: André Janones (Rede-MG) encourages Lula supporters to search 'Bolsonaro Talvane Albuquerque' on Google, aiming to recover a speech by Jair Bolsonaro defending Talvane Albuquerque, later convicted of ordering the murder of federal deputy Marielle Franco. The strategy seeks to associate past figures with corruption and violence cases amid a polarized political landscape. Janones criticizes linking Lula to corruption schemes while highlighting the violent history of Bolsonaro allies.

item.title: Nova pesquisa para presidente hoje: o que dizem os levantamentos dessa quinta (22)
item.description: Polls released on Thursday (22) show Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in projections for the 2026 second round, though margins of error keep the race within a technical tie. Institutes PoderData/Aya, Quaest, Meio/Ideia, Palver, and RealTime Big Data recorded variations between 45% and 52% for Bolsonaro and 44% to 50% for Lula, depending on vote counting criteria (valid or total votes).

item.title: TSE dá 24h para Meta detalhar canal “Exército do Lula”
item.description: The TSE ordered Meta to submit a detailed technical report on the 'Exército do Lula' channel within 24 hours, following a request from Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign (PL) to verify compliance plans and detect potential coordination irregularities or artificial content amplification. The ruling also requires explanation of criteria distinguishing legitimate mobilization from coordinated behavior and analysis of activities from October 18-20, 2026.

item.title: Crusoé: Deltan acusa PT de “estelionato eleitoral”
item.description: Senator-elect Deltan Dallagnol (Novo-PR) accused the PT of committing an “electoral scam,” claiming the party used images of documents that would not be confidential from President Lula. He said he was alerted by Senator-elect Gustavo Gayer about the release of these photos. The accusation was published in a video on Thursday morning.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula e Janones promovem live
item.description: Lula and Janones hold a live stream to mobilize supporters in the final stretch of the presidential runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Pacote de bondades não teve viés eleitoral, diz Durigan
item.description: Minister of Finance Dario Durigan stated that President Lula's benefit package has no electoral bias and improved public accounts by 200 billion reais compared to the Bolsonaro administration. He emphasized fiscal discipline and the 16 billion reais budget blockage in 2026 as evidence of expense control.

item.title: Neymar aproveita postagem de MC Cabelinho para declarar voto em Flávio Bolsonaro: 'Dito isso, 22'
item.description: Neymar Jr. expressed support for Flávio Bolsonaro by commenting on a post by MC Cabelinho on Instagram ahead of the election runoff. The video, produced by the Revelando Brasil project, questions Flávio's political trajectory but was removed by Instagram over alleged AI use. The player's comment received over 185,000 likes.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro x Lula: veja quem Augusto Cury, Renan Santos e outros candidatos a presidente derrotados no 1º turno apoiam
item.description: Five former candidates endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro in the runoff, including Romeu Zema and Ronaldo Caiado, while three backed Lula, such as Edmilson Costa. Others remained neutral or critical, reflecting polarization among first-round losers.

item.title: A cautela na campanha de Lula com a 'virada' dos trackings
item.description: Piauí Governor Rafael Fonteles celebrated tracking polls showing Lula leading Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round. The article highlights Lula's cautious approach in a crucial election moment. Content is exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: Herdeiro do Beto Carrero doa R$ 500 mil para campanha de Flávio
item.description: Alex Murad, CEO and son of the founder of Beto Carrero World, donated R$500,000 to Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign in the second round of the 2026 elections. In the first round, he also made three donations in Santa Catarina, including R$350,000 to the state directory of the PL. The donation to the candidate was registered with the Electoral Justice five days before the second round.

item.title: "Sou progressista": irmã da ex-deputada Carla Zambelli anuncia voto em Lula
item.description: Paula Brasil, sister of former lawmaker Carla Zambelli, endorsed Lula in the runoff, emphasizing ideological differences with her family. She identifies as progressive and chose to break her silence to preserve her voice.

item.title: ONU marca julgamento de denúncia sobre milícias no RJ motivada pelo caso Ana Clara e que cita Flávio
item.description: The UN scheduled, for December 2025 in Geneva, the trial of an international complaint against Brazil, motivated by the death of 5-year-old Ana Clara Machado in 2021. The case, involving militias in Rio de Janeiro, explicitly cites Flávio Bolsonaro. The complaint questions the Brazilian state's responsibility in combating violence and organized crime.

item.title: Flávio acusa governo de usar dados sigilosos para disparar mensagens favoráveis a Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro filed a lawsuit at the TSE accusing the federal government of using confidential data from program beneficiaries to send electoral messages via WhatsApp during the election blackout period. The indictment points to a suspected illegal operation dubbed 'Serviço na Ponta', involving the Casa Civil, SECOM, and ministries such as Management and Social Security. The campaign requests suspension of the sends, ineligibility of those involved, and annulment of Lula's ticket for abuse of power.

item.title: Advogado e idealizador da Lei da Ficha Limpa declara voto em Lula no 2º turno: 'Convicção democrática'
item.description: Márlon Reis, creator of the Clean Record Law, declared support for Lula in the second round, citing 'democratic conviction' and criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro for disregard of social causes. Reis emphasized that Lula's convictions were annulled by the Supreme Court and advocated for including treason as a heinous crime in the Penal Code.

item.title: Deputado do PT aciona PGR para investigar suspeitas de corrupção envolvendo Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Congressman Rui Falcão (PT) files a complaint with the PGR to investigate corruption allegations against Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), linking R$4 million transfers from a lawyer to his former Senate term during a vote on his reappointment to the CNMP. The investigation highlights irregularities in payment justifications and potential ties to parliamentary actions.

item.title: Ato de Nunes Marques libera alcance indiscriminado de redes da Meta e favorece Nikolas e Marçal
item.description: TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques authorized Meta to resume automatic recommendations of politicians who dropped out after the first round, benefiting allies of Flávio Bolsonaro such as Nikolas Ferreira and Pablo Marçal.

item.title: “Globo” anuncia checagem de fatos para o debate de Lula e Flávio
item.description: TV Globo announced it will conduct real-time fact-checking during the presidential debate between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), using the Fato ou Fake service. The effort will involve teams from g1, O Globo, Extra, Valor Econômico, and CBN, broadcast after Jornal Nacional. This is the final debate before the 2026 runoff election.

item.title: Ao vivo: PoderDataCast analisa os resultados da pesquisa PoderData/Aya
item.description: PoderDataCast will analyze the latest PoderData/Aya poll results live, focusing on the race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro just days before the 2026 runoff. The show airs Thursday, Oct 22 at 6:30 PM BRT on YouTube, hosted by Jonathan Karter and Mateus Netzel, discussing voter trends and electoral dynamics.

item.title: A 3 dias da eleição, Nunes Marques manda Meta enviar dados sobre o canal ‘Exército do Lula’
item.description: Three days before the election, the president of the TSE, Nunes Marques, ordered Meta to submit a technical report within 24 hours on the functioning of the WhatsApp channel 'Exército do Lula', suspected of coordinating mass searches to discredit Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign. The decision was made upon a request from the senator's campaign, which alleges that the channel influences search trends on Google and social media by directing unfavorable news. The minister also ordered the company to prove compliance with the Compliance Plan and preserve all channel records.

item.title: Mensagens revelam presente de R$ 500 mil de Daniel Vorcaro para Lula
item.description: Leaked messages from the Brazilian Federal Police reveal that Daniel Vorcaro ordered the purchase of a rare Macallan 1945 bottle, valued at BRL 500,000, as a gift for President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The operation, coordinated by Vorcaro and an assistant, involved a global search for a bottle imported directly from London via Dubai, with delivery expected on Thursday following Lula's birthday on September 27.

item.title: Apoiadores de Lula protestam no TSE por abertura de sigilos
item.description: Lula's supporters protested at the TSE as the campaign submitted a request to lift banking, fiscal and phone secrecy demanded by Flávio Bolsonaro. The document authorizes the Supreme Court to obtain data from the Alcazar Holdings offshore linked to money laundering investigations involving Flávio Bolsonaro. The move occurs before the 2026 runoff vote.

item.title: Celina cita obras em Planaltina e prevê equipamentos públicos no Arapoanga
item.description: Governor Celina Leão (PP) held a campaign rally in Planaltina, highlighting completed infrastructure works and pledging public facilities in Arapoanga. The event was supported by Senator Damares Alves and Deputy Pepa, strengthening coordination ahead of the second-round elections.

item.title: Herdeiro de Beto Carrero, CEO do parque injeta meio milhão na campanha de Flávio
item.description: Alexandre Von Janke Murad, CEO of Beto Carrero World, donated BRL 500,000 to Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, totaling BRL 1.05 million in contributions this election cycle. His long-standing support for the Bolsonaro family includes a controversial 2022 promotion during the presidential runoff.

item.title: Parlamentares dos EUA cobram explicações de Zuckerberg sobre ações da Meta na eleição brasileira
item.description: Thirteen U.S. lawmakers are demanding answers from Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg regarding alleged bias in content moderation during the Brazilian elections, accusing the company of unequal treatment toward the campaigns of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro. The letter cites incidents such as the AI on WhatsApp refusing to generate images for Lula’s campaign and the temporary suspension of Lula’s ads on Facebook, prompting action and fines from the Brazilian Electoral Court. The lawmakers are seeking a meeting and written responses by November 4.

item.title: Ministério cobra governo de SP após foto de presos usando camisetas de Lula
item.description: The Ministry of Justice requested explanations from the São Paulo government after young people were arrested wearing Lula supporter shirts, suspected of police coercion. The Ombudsman requested the removal of accused military police officers. The mother of one involved claims the arrest was staged.

item.title: Durigan rebate Flávio e diz que reforma já garante devolução de tributos: 'Isso já é lei'
item.description: Finance Minister Daro Durigan stated that the tax reform already provides for tax refunds to low-income consumers, rejecting Flávio Bolsonaro's proposal to return taxes via Pix. Durigan emphasized that the ICMS exemption on basic products is already a legal reality, deeming the parliamentarian's suggestion unnecessary.

item.title: Projeto proíbe plataformas de induzir uso compulsivo e manipular usuários
item.description: PL 1421/26 prohibits digital platforms from using design and algorithms to artificially or abusively capture user attention, such as infinite scroll and compulsive notifications. The bill also bans dark patterns and opaque data use to influence public debates and elections, with fines of up to 2% of revenue in Brazil. It is under review in the Chamber and heading to thematic committees.

item.title: Flávio tem 50,6% dos votos válidos e Lula, 49,4%, diz pesquisa
item.description: Indexa/Broadcast poll shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (50.6%) and Lula (49.4%) in the runoff, with a 2.2-point margin of error.

item.title: Meta derruba vídeo de MC Cabelinho sobre Flávio
item.description: Meta removed a video featuring rapper MC Cabelinho in collaboration with the portal Revelando about PL presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro from Instagram Reels, but the content remains available on YouTube. The move raises questions about content moderation and freedom of expression on digital platforms during the election period.

item.title: Corregedor do TSE nega pedido de Flávio Bolsonaro para suspender mensagens do governo
item.description: The Chief Electoral Court Officer, Justice Minister Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, rejected Flávio Bolsonaro's request to suspend official government messaging, citing risks to public communications. The ruling was issued in an electoral investigation involving Lula, Alckmin and Sidônio Palmeira.

item.title: Deltan: “Última vez que analisei documentos, Lula foi parar na cadeia”
item.description: Former federal prosecutor Deltan Dallagnol stated at the TSE that the last time he analyzed Lula's documents, the investigation led to the PT leader's imprisonment. Hired by Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign to review the president's bank, tax, and phone records, Deltan demanded an analysis dating back to 2003. He criticized the PS campaign's formal agreement to open secrecy without submitting the requested documents.

item.title: “Povo vai ver quem é ladrão e quem não é”, diz Camilo Santana
item.description: Camilo Santana advocates for the opening of bank, tax, and phone secrecy of Lula and Flavio Bolsonaro so the population can assess the conduct of both politicians. The PT agreed to 19 conditions of the PL for disclosure of data, while Flavio demands analysis of Lula's records since 2003 before authorizing the presentation of his documents.

item.title: Entidades brasileiras pedem investigação da Meta ao Congresso dos EUA
item.description: The Vladimir Herzog Institute and CTRL+Z have requested the U.S. Congress to investigate suspected favoritism by Meta toward Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy in the 2026 elections, alleging undue influence by major digital platforms in the Brazilian electoral process.

item.title: MPE diz que Meta descumpriu parte de decisões do TSE e vê falta de isonomia
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry states that Meta failed to comply with part of the TSE's decisions regarding content treatment during the presidential election runoff. The ministry also points to unequal use of the company's platforms.

item.title: Richarlison mostra documentos após cobrança de Willer Tomaz
item.description: Richarlison shared legal documents on Instagram to verify his purchase of a property in Ilha Comprida, responding to lawyer Willer Tomaz, who pledged to transfer the property rights if valid proof was shown. The dispute involves Sport 70, a partner company of the player, and Tomaz's WT Administração, which claims to have acquired the rights through an agreement with M Locadora. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro was mentioned as a witness but denied any involvement with the property. In 2025, the Superior Court of Justice upheld a ruling favorable to WT, and Sport 70's lawsuit was dismissed without ruling on the merits.

item.title: Câmara e Senado fazem cobertura integrada do segundo turno das eleições
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies and the Senate conduct integrated coverage of the 2026 election runoff with live broadcasts starting at 2 PM on the Chamber's Portal. Over 30 legislative TV and radio stations participate, providing analysis, interviews and political context with experts and electoral authorities. The production highlights active social participation through the Legislative Power.

item.title: Crusoé: Pesquisa Indexa reforça estabilidade entre Flávio e Lula
item.description: Indexa poll shows technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT), with 45.2% and 44.1% voting intentions, respectively. Whites and nulls total 4.3%, undecided 1.6%, and 4.8% of interviewees said they will not vote.

item.title: O que apontam os trackings de Lula e Flávio a poucos dias da eleição
item.description: A few days before the 2026 presidential runoff, internal campaign trackings for Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) show diverging trends. While Lula's internal polls indicate a technical tie at 50% each, the main PL tracking shows a three-point lead for Flávio. Official published polls also confirm a technical tie, though most show a slight lead for the PL candidate.

item.title: PV fecha questão por reeleição de Hugo Motta à presidência da Câmara
item.description: The Green Party (PV) caucus decided to support Hugo Motta's (Republicanos-PB) re-election as President of the Chamber of Deputies during a meeting held on Wednesday, the 21st. The gathering also included the induction of four new lawmakers and reaffirmed the party’s backing for President Lula’s re-election ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Famosos declaram apoio a Lula e Flávio, mas não votam
item.description: Celebrities who publicly supported Lula or Flávio Bolsonaro did not vote in the first round, with some justifying their absence and others having canceled voter registration. Singer Anitta and presenter Fábio Porchat had their absence justification approved, while Luana Piovani, Matuê, and Cellbit appear with canceled registration. Some used their platforms to mobilize political support via social media and coordinated campaigns.

item.title: Pedras votando em britadeiras (por Felipe Sampaio)
item.description: The text reflects on the 2026 Brazilian election, highlighting support for candidates who, according to the author, harmed the country in the past, amid a more conservative political and social scenario. The analysis points to a growing defense of punitive policies, such as the death penalty, and the relevance of decisions based on government performance, criticizing electoral amnesia.

item.title: Equipe de Flávio prevê economia de R$ 450 bi ao enxugar servidores públicos com IA
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's economic team coordinator, Daniella Marques, stated that his government could save R$450 billion by replacing 12 million public servants with artificial intelligence. The remarks, made in August, went viral after being published by Folha de S.Paulo. Marques also expects a R$150 billion reduction in spending on outsourced personnel and technology.

item.title: Que horas será o debate presidencial da Globo nesta sexta? Veja como assistir
item.description: The TV Globo presidential debate between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) will take place on Friday (23) at 9:20 PM, following the nightly news. The debate will be broadcast live across the network’s platforms, including free-to-air TV, the g1 website, GloboNews, and Globoplay.

item.title: Ao vivo: TSE julga pedido de resposta contra Lula por uso de foto
item.description: The Brazilian Electoral Court (TSE) will rule on Thursday (Oct 22, 2026) on the right of response filed by Val Meliga against Lula and the 'Brazil Ready for More' coalition for unauthorized use of her image in electoral advertising. The PT campaign, titled 'Which Brazil Do You Want?', aired a statement calling Val Meliga and her group 'criminals and corrupt', prompting the honor offense claim.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Rio terá transporte público gratuito no 2º turno
item.description: Rio de Janeiro provides free public transport for the 2026 election runoff on Sunday, covering buses, BRT, VLT and vans from morning to evening. The measure, set by TSE and TRE-RJ resolutions, aims to facilitate voters' access to polling stations.

item.title: Equipe de Lula diz que PMs mandaram presos vestirem camisas do PT
item.description: PT filed a lawsuit with the Electoral Prosecutor's Office to investigate the São Paulo Military Police after a video showed detainees wearing pro-Lula shirts, alleging that officers forced them to wear the shirts to spread electoral misinformation. The mother of a teenage detainee reported physical abuse and police entering her home. The incident occurred in Piracicaba during a drug trafficking operation.

item.title: Transporte público do DF no 2º turno será gratuito e terá frota de dia útil
item.description: Public transportation in the Federal District will be free and operate on a weekday schedule on Sunday (October 25th) during the second round of the 2026 elections, as established by Article 23 of TSE Resolution No. 23,751/2026. The measure exempts lines serving the Esplanada dos Ministérios, SIA, and Saan, maintaining Sunday schedules. The operation includes fleet reinforcement and real-time monitoring.
